name: Video Embed Plus
description: Auto-add a video embed field with thumbnails to content types.
project_description:
Features 
 Video Embed Plus extends video support in Drupal by allowing you to embed videos from multiple providers, with custom display options. Includes UI configuration and support for media fields.

 Installation and Configuration 
 
 Install the module like any other Drupal module. 
 Activate the module from the modules page. 
 Go to the content settings and add a field of type field_video_embed . 
 Customize the options from the field configuration section. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires Drupal 10 or higher. It does not depend on external libraries.
